data.name: Truck City
data.detailed_description:
City builder

Grow your truck fleet, build your city and design a supply chain to extract, refine and process natural resources into complex items.

Logistics manager

Set up the priority of your factories, manage your trucks, carefully design your roads to prevent traffic jams. Sell your surpluses to earn money to continue growing your city. Buy missing resources or automate the production of complex items.

Research upgrades

Unlock new research and improve your trucks stats, optimize factory throughput and efficiency, and minimize truck loading and unloading times.
